correctness.rationale: For every integer \(k\ge2\), the five specified maps on \(\mathbb Z/k\mathbb Z\times\{0,1\}\) square to the identity. The hidden closure partitions the \(2k\) states into exactly \(k\) pairs. The two observable reflections compose to a rotation, and conjugates of the pair transposition generate \(S_k\). A single additional observable involution adds any chosen missing pair after conjugating by a pair permutation. Consequently all \(2^k-1\) nonempty unions are reachable; a permutation carrying an index in the symmetric difference to the accepting index distinguishes any two. Original-state transitivity plus singleton acceptance proves the input is minimal. Exhaustive projected subset minimization for \(2\le k\le10\) and 4095 direct erasure comparisons independently corroborate the construction; the infinite claim follows from the symbolic proof.

originality.rationale: Hoffmann (arXiv:2108.06976, Sections 3--4) already established the general upper bound \(2^{n-\lceil m/2\rceil}-1\), so it is not claimed as new. His seven-letter witness theorem explicitly assumes \(0<2m+1<n\) and does not provide the full-matching endpoint \(m=n=2k\). The present minimal five-letter, all-involution witness attains this endpoint and exhibits nonclosure of deterministic undirected languages under letter erasure. Kutrib--Malcher--Schneider (2021) defines DUFAs but does not give this projection witness. Indexed searches yielded no implication covering the restricted endpoint. The residual possibility of an unindexed equivalent construction is recorded.
residual_risks: An unindexed or inaccessible construction may already attain the same full-matching bound using involutive letters; the claim is qualified by this remaining literature risk.
Hoffmann already proved the numerical bound. Originality attaches only to the restricted exact witness and its fixed five-letter alphabet, not to that bound.
No smallest possible alphabet size or odd-state parameter is established.

value.rationale: Letter erasure is a classical formal-language operation whose deterministic state blow-up measures the cost of hiding transitions. The existing tight permutation-automaton bound left a concrete endpoint gap for its published witnesses, namely every state moved by an erased letter. An explicit all-involution witness sharp at this boundary and uniform over all even state sizes addresses a motivated structural problem: the restricted input machine is minimal, uses a constant alphabet of five letters, yields exactly all nonempty hidden-pair unions, and leaves the restricted language class after erasure. No downstream theorem is assumed; the exact extremal construction and class separation have independent value.
